summary: Iteration 19: Verified global removal of 'presentation' status across UI and API. Backend 6/6 pytest passed. /api/statuses returns exactly {not_interested, follow_up, leads, file} (no presentation). Admin Dashboard, Admin Reports (Summary + Hourly), Admin Data/Leads, Telecaller Dashboard, and Telecaller Data all render without any 'Presentation' label. Status filter chips on telecaller data page show exactly: All | New | Not Interested | Follow Up | Lead | File. Reports Summary Overall Performance metrics tile row has no Presentation card. Hourly report table (empty state today) shows no P column. Pagination on /admin/leads works (2 total data shown).

minor.issue: Response payload still contains legacy fields 'presentations', 'total_presentations', and 'status_counts.presentation' (always 0 for new data). Not visible to user because frontend ignores them, but should be cleaned up for consistency with the 'global removal' goal.

Backend still computes and returns 'presentations'/'total_presentations' in each telecaller/overall_hourly item and matches status=='presentation' in the aggregation. Dead code path — should be removed to match front-end removal.

issues: Pre-existing (iter18) hydration warnings from instrumentation <span> wrappers around <select>/<option>/<table>/<tbody>/<tfoot>. Non-blocking, injected by preview tooling.

action_items: Optional cleanup: remove residual 'presentation' references in backend routes/reports.py get_telecaller_reports() (user_presentations, total_presentations, leads.get('presentation',0)) and get_hourly_report() (hours[hour]['presentations'], status=='presentation' branch, overall_hourly presentations key).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/reports.py get_telecaller_reports still computes user_presentations = leads.get('presentation', 0) and returns 'total_presentations' in overall — dead field, remove to keep API contract in sync with UI.

routes/reports.py get_hourly_report still branches on status == 'presentation' and includes 'presentations' in overall_hourly filter condition (line 754). Since /api/statuses no longer returns presentation, this branch is unreachable for new data but still pollutes the response schema.
Frontend TC Dashboard comment on line ~84 says 'without new and presentation' — accurate, but consider removing the historical reference in the comment for clarity.
